description: This file implements a Ruby client for the Testlink API using XMLRPC. It defines a class for interacting with the Testlink server, including a method for reporting test case results. The script initializes a client instance and performs a sample report, printing the result.

classes.name: TestlinkAPIClient
classes.description: A Ruby class encapsulating interactions with the Testlink API via XMLRPC, primarily for reporting test case results.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the XMLRPC client with the server URL and sets the developer key.

methods.name: reportTCResult
methods.description: Sends a report of a test case result to the Testlink server via XMLRPC, using provided test case ID, plan ID, and status.
